g.text: Previously reported test sets; no new model selection. NDCG deltas × 100; recall deltas in percentage points.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516274

g.text: Read each panel independently. Positive means the left/full configuration scores higher; negative means the variant scores higher.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516274

g.text: Effects overlap and must not be added. Intervals quantify query-sampling uncertainty, not training-seed or new-test generalization.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516274

g.text: CE = CrossEncoder. Pool statistics are derived from CE scores; dropping raw CE does not remove all neural information.
